mlag.note: Two FortiSwitch units form an active/active MCLAG pair (maximum two; same model and firmware recommended). Supported with FortiLink MCLAG peer groups and in standalone mode. Layer-3 routing inside the MCLAG is limited to VRRP and static routes

stacking.note: No hardware stacking. A FortiGate manages 8 to 300 switches (model dependent) as one fabric with automatic inter-switch links

routing.summary: Static routing; OSPF, RIP, VRRP with Advanced Features license. No BGP

power.summary: Fixed PSU; optional FRPS-740 external RPS on PoE models

redundancy.detail: Fixed internal PSU, no built-in redundancy.

licensing: No license needed when managed by a FortiGate over FortiLink. Dynamic routing needs the Advanced Features license (FS-SW-LIC-xxx). Cloud or standalone management is a separate subscription

redundancy.detail: Optional FRPS-740 external redundant power supply, sold separately. Not included with the switch.
